title: Wall Art — one Math Engine, framed pieces arranged as a row, a pair, a triptych or a grid
description:
A parametric WALL ART arrangement on the six-node spine — Geometry → Input Properties → Math Engine → Output Metrics → 2D Render + 3D Render.

DROP IT ON A SEGMENT. It hangs one piece or a whole wall of them, which is why the plan's "one framed art piece or a pair of decorative panels" is one object and not a decision taken at modelling time.

ARRANGEMENT SETS THE COUNTS AND NOTHING ELSE. `_nc` and `_nr` are the only two numbers the five arrangements disagree about — Single is 1 × 1, Pair is 2 × 1, Triptych is 3 × 1, Row is `count` × 1, Grid is `count` × `rows`. Every piece position, the overall size and all the metrics are written in those two, so there is no fifth body hiding anywhere.

EVERY PIECE IS ONE BROADCAST. `kron(arange(_nc), ones(_nr,1))` crossed with `kron(ones(_nc,1), arange(_nr))` is every column-and-row pair at once, so a 1 × 1 single and a 4 × 3 grid take the identical path.

THE FRAME CORNERS BUTT, THEY DO NOT OVERLAP. The stiles run full height and the rails sit between them, so no millimetre of frame is counted twice and the mitre-free joint is the honest one for a box frame.

THE HANG IS FROM THE CENTRE. `centreHeight` is the centre of the whole arrangement, not of the first piece — so adding a row grows the group about its centre line and the hang stays where you put it.

THE MAT IS A SECOND FRAME INSIDE THE FIRST, in its own group. Turn it off and the art sheet takes the full opening, because the art's bounds are written in terms of the mat width, which is then zero.

DIMENSIONS AT THE DEFAULTS: one 0.60 × 0.90 m piece centred at 1.50 m, 40 mm frame, 50 mm mat, 0.54 m² of wall covered and 0.30 m² of visible art.

WHAT THIS CANNOT DO. Every piece is the same size — a salon hang of mixed frames is several of these. Frames are rectangular and square-sectioned, with no moulding profile, and there is no glass, no reflection and no canvas wrap.

props.name: Material
props.value: stained oak frame, ivory mount board, matte print

props.name: Semantics
props.value: understated framed artwork, neutral tones, gallery hang, calm

params.name: Wall Art maths
params.expr:
# Arrangement is the ONLY thing that sets the counts; everything after is written in _nc / _nr.
_isSingle = arrangement == 'Single'
_isPair = arrangement == 'Pair'
_isTri = arrangement == 'Triptych'
_isGrid = arrangement == 'Grid'
_nc = _isSingle ? 1 : (_isPair ? 2 : (_isTri ? 3 : max(1, round(count))))
_nr = _isGrid ? max(1, round(rows)) : 1
_sp = spacing
_natL = _nc * width + (_nc - 1) * _sp
# Host frame — node, segment or space
_e1 = hcat(1, 0)
_np = rows(P)
_isSeg = _np == 2
_isSpace = _np > 2
_edges = _isSpace ? (shift(P, -1) - P) : _e1
_edgeLen = len(_edges)
_longest = max(_edgeLen)
_spaceDir = _isSpace ? row(compress(_edges, eq(_edgeLen, _longest)), 0) : _e1
_segDir = _isSeg ? (row(P, 1) - row(P, 0)) : _e1
_dir = _isSpace ? _spaceDir : (_isSeg ? _segDir : _e1)
_dirLen = len(_dir)
_axisB = _dirLen > 0 ? normalize(_dir) : _e1
_rot = rotation * PI / 180
_crot = cos(_rot)
_srot = sin(_rot)
_bx = sub(_axisB, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_by = sub(_axisB, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_axisU = hcat(_bx * _crot - _by * _srot, _bx * _srot + _by * _crot)
_axisV = (flipSide > 0 ? -1 : 1) * perp(_axisU)
_ux = sub(_axisU, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_uy = sub(_axisU, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_vx = sub(_axisV, 0, 0, 1, 1)
_vy = sub(_axisV, 0, 1, 1, 1)
_Qu = col(P, 0) * _ux + col(P, 1) * _uy
_Qv = col(P, 0) * _vx + col(P, 1) * _vy
_hu0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qu) : 0
_hu1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qu) : 0
_hv0 = _np > 0 ? min(_Qv) : 0
_hv1 = _np > 0 ? max(_Qv) : 0
_hcu = (_hu0 + _hu1) / 2
_hcv = (_hv0 + _hv1) / 2
_hostL = _hu1 - _hu0
_hostW = _hv1 - _hv0
# Fit to host — one uniform scale, Max never enlarges
_availL = max(0, _hostL - 2 * margin)
_notOff = fitMode != 'Off'
_exact = fitMode == 'Exact'
_sRaw = _natL > 0 ? _availL / _natL : 1
_sFit = (_notOff && _availL > 0) ? (_exact ? _sRaw : min(1, _sRaw)) : 1
scale = max(0.15, min(5, _sFit))
_s = scale
_w = width * _s
_h = height * _s
_gap = _sp * _s
_fw = min(frameWidth * _s, min(_w, _h) / 4)
_fd = frameDepth * _s
_ad = artDepth * _s
_mw = showMat > 0 ? min(matWidth * _s, min(_w, _h) / 2 - _fw - 0.005) : 0
_TW = _nc * _w + (_nc - 1) * _gap
_TH = _nr * _h + (_nr - 1) * _gap
_bodyL = _TW
_bodyW = _fd
# Anchor — place the footprint by any of the nine box points
_anchorL = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Left-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left'
_anchorR = anchorDir == 'Top-Right' || anchorDir == 'Right-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_anchorT = anchorDir == 'Top-Left' || anchorDir == 'Top-Center' || anchorDir == 'Top-Right'
_anchorB = anchorDir == 'Bottom-Left' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Center' || anchorDir == 'Bottom-Right'
_ax = _anchorR - _anchorL
_ay = _anchorB - _anchorT
_hau = _hcu + _ax * max(0, _hostL / 2 - margin)
_hav = _hcv + _ay * max(0, _hostW / 2 - margin)
_cu = _hau - _ax * _bodyL / 2
_cv = _hav - _ay * _bodyW / 2
_v1 = _fd / 2
_wall = _v1
_fv0 = _wall - _fd
# Every piece's corner in one broadcast — columns crossed with rows.
_N = _nc * _nr
_ic = kron(arange(_nc), ones(_nr, 1))
_ir = kron(ones(_nc, 1), arange(_nr))
_pu0 = 0 - _TW / 2 + _ic * (_w + _gap)
_pu1 = _pu0 + _w
_pz0 = centreHeight - _TH / 2 + _ir * (_h + _gap)
_pz1 = _pz0 + _h
_one = fill(_N, 1, 1)
_vA = _one * _fv0
_vB = _one * _wall
# Frame — four rails per piece. Left and right run the full height; top and bottom sit between
# them, so the corners butt rather than overlap and the frame area is not double-counted.
_RL1 = hcat(_pu0, _vA, _pu0 + _fw, _vA, _pu0 + _fw, _vB, _pu0, _vB, _pz0, _pz1, _one)
_FR = hcat(_pu1 - _fw, _vA, _pu1, _vA, _pu1, _vB, _pu1 - _fw, _vB, _pz0, _pz1, _one)
_FB = hcat(_pu0 + _fw, _vA, _pu1 - _fw, _vA, _pu1 - _fw, _vB, _pu0 + _fw, _vB, _pz0, _pz0 + _fw, _one)
_FT = hcat(_pu0 + _fw, _vA, _pu1 - _fw, _vA, _pu1 - _fw, _vB, _pu0 + _fw, _vB, _pz1 - _fw, _pz1, _one)
_FRAME = vcat(_RL1, _FR, _FB, _FT)
# Mat board — a second frame just inside the first, in its own group so it can be a different
# colour without being a different body.
_mu0 = _pu0 + _fw
_mu1 = _pu1 - _fw
_mz0 = _pz0 + _fw
_mz1 = _pz1 - _fw
_mv0 = _one * (_wall - _fd * 0.55)
_mvB = _one * (_wall - _fd * 0.35)
_two = _one * 2
_ML = hcat(_mu0, _mv0, _mu0 + _mw, _mv0, _mu0 + _mw, _mvB, _mu0, _mvB, _mz0, _mz1, _two)
_MR = hcat(_mu1 - _mw, _mv0, _mu1, _mv0, _mu1, _mvB, _mu1 - _mw, _mvB, _mz0, _mz1, _two)
_MB = hcat(_mu0 + _mw, _mv0, _mu1 - _mw, _mv0, _mu1 - _mw, _mvB, _mu0 + _mw, _mvB, _mz0, _mz0 + _mw, _two)
_MT = hcat(_mu0 + _mw, _mv0, _mu1 - _mw, _mv0, _mu1 - _mw, _mvB, _mu0 + _mw, _mvB, _mz1 - _mw, _mz1, _two)
_MAT = _mw > 0.001 ? vcat(_ML, _MR, _MB, _MT) : zeros(0, 11)
# Art sheet — inside the mat if there is one, otherwise inside the frame.
_au0 = _mu0 + _mw
_au1 = _mu1 - _mw
_az0 = _mz0 + _mw
_az1 = _mz1 - _mw
_av0 = _one * (_wall - _fd * 0.4 - _ad)
_av1 = _one * (_wall - _fd * 0.4)
_three = _one * 3
_ART = hcat(_au0, _av0, _au1, _av0, _au1, _av1, _au0, _av1, _az0, _az1, _three)
Q = vcat(_FRAME, _MAT, _ART)
# Quad prism — every part is a quad swept from z0 to z1 (6 faces)
_nq = rows(Q)
_r4 = ones(4,1)
_a1 = col(Q,0)
_b1 = col(Q,1)
_a2 = col(Q,2)
_b2 = col(Q,3)
_a3 = col(Q,4)
_b3 = col(Q,5)
_a4 = col(Q,6)
_b4 = col(Q,7)
_qz0 = col(Q,8)
_qz1 = col(Q,9)
_gq = kron(col(Q,10), _r4)
_fq = kron(arange(_nq), _r4) * 6
_q0 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 0, _gq)
_q1 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 1, _gq)
_q2 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a2,_b2,_qz1,_a1,_b1,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 2, _gq)
_q3 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a2,_b2,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a3,_b3,_qz1,_a2,_b2,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 3, _gq)
_q4 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a3,_b3,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a4,_b4,_qz1,_a3,_b3,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 4, _gq)
_q5 = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a4,_b4,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz0,_a1,_b1,_qz1,_a4,_b4,_qz1), 4*_nq, 3), _fq + 5, _gq)
_FL = vcat(_q0,_q1,_q2,_q3,_q4,_q5)
_PL = hcat(reshape(hcat(_a1,_b1,_a2,_b2,_a3,_b3,_a4,_b4), 4*_nq, 2), kron(arange(_nq), _r4), _gq)
# Local (u,v,z) -> world, once, for every part at the same time
_U = _cu + col(_FL,0)
_V = _cv + col(_FL,1)
_W = hcat(_U * _ux + _V * _vx, _U * _uy + _V * _vy, col(_FL,2), col(_FL,3), col(_FL,4))
_nw = rows(_W)
_PU = _cu + col(_PL,0)
_PV = _cv + col(_PL,1)
_WP = hcat(_PU * _ux + _PV * _vx, _PU * _uy + _PV * _vy, col(_PL,2), col(_PL,3))
_nwp = rows(_WP)
Frames3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 1)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Mats3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 2)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
Art3D = sub(compress(_W, eq(col(_W,4), 3)), 0, 0, _nw, 4)
FramesPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 1)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
ArtPlan = sub(compress(_WP, eq(col(_WP,3), 3)), 0, 0, _nwp, 3)
# Metrics
pieceCount = _N
columns = _nc
rowCount = _nr
pieceWidth = _w
pieceHeight = _h
totalWidth = _TW
totalHeight = _TH
bottomOfFrame = centreHeight - _TH / 2
topOfFrame = centreHeight + _TH / 2
projection = _fd
coverageArea = _TW * _TH
artArea = sum(max(0, _au1 - _au0) * max(0, _az1 - _az0))
